doc.title: Case Packer Setup and Glue Check
doc.file: WI-213 Case Packer Setup and Glue Check.pdf
doc.purpose: Erect, pack and seal shipper cases that survive the pallet.

roles.name: Maintenance Technician
roles.does: Services the glue system and the vacuum pump.

references.as_written: MP-502 Case Packer Vacuum Pump Inspection

parameters.quote: Glue tank set to 175 degrees C.
Check the vacuum gauge on the case erector reads at least 0.6 bar of vacuum with a case on the cups.
Run three cases. Check they are square and that all four flaps are glued.
Every hour: tear open one sealed case.

rules.statement: For any work inside the guards the Operator locks out as described in SP-402 (no revision given).
rules.quote: For any work inside the guards, lock out as described in SP-402.

rules.statement: Operators check the cups, then call the Maintenance Technician for low vacuum.
rules.quote: Low vacuum or cases not erecting: check the cups for wear, then call the Maintenance Technician (see MP-502).

unsure.what: Rev B (2022) says nothing about the glue tank cool-down or tagged lid that SP-402 Rev D (2025) added for case packers
unsure.why: WI-213 just points to SP-402 and does not say who locks out beyond 'the Operator'
